dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: Care to look at some Snezhnograd souvenirs? High quality, low price, beyond your expectations — I guarantee you won't be disappointed!

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: That's right, you heard me. Souvenirs exclusive to Snezhnograd, meant to preserve the beautiful memories people make in this great city.

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: What do you think? Who wouldn't want to preserve their beautiful memories of this great city? Just look at the customers I get—

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: Every visitor to Snezhnograd, whether foreigners like yourself or out-of-towners from places like Novokitezhgrad or Morepesok.

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: And I, Dariya, have special supply channels. So everything I sell is high quality and low price. Across all of Snezhnograd, you won't find a better deal.

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: As long as travelers keep coming to Snezhnograd, my business will do just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are these souvenirs different from the ones in regular shops?

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: Very different! In shops, all you'll find are the most generic, most ordinary gifts, and you'll still pay a premium for them.

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: But here — let me be honest with you — I've got... certain connections within the Transport Bureau.

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: So even with the Project Stuzha in effect, everything you find here is the most unexpected and the most cost-effective you could imagine.

dialogues.speaker: Dariya
dialogues.text: Whether it's premium-grade Prime Ice products, or signed photos of Odette and Vodyanitsa... these are things you simply won't find in any ordinary shop.
